features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Scan product barcodes with a camera or handheld scanner to look up and update items.
user_stories: As a store clerk, I can scan a barcode so that I can instantly find or update a product.
As a store manager, I can register new products by scanning so that onboarding stock is fast.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid barcode, When it is scanned, Then the product details appear within 1 second.
Given an unknown barcode, When it is scanned, Then the system offers to create a new product.

features.name: Real-Time Stock Tracking
features.description: Stock levels update instantly across all devices when sales, receipts or adjustments occur.
user_stories: As a store clerk, I can see current stock levels so that I avoid selling items that are out of stock.
As a store manager, I can view live inventory on any device so that I make accurate decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock change on one device, When it is saved, Then all other connected devices show it within 2 seconds.
Given a sale is recorded, When it completes, Then the item quantity decreases by the sold amount.

features.name: Low-Stock Alerts and Reordering
features.description: Notify staff when items fall below a configurable threshold and suggest reorder quantities.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can set reorder thresholds so that I am warned before items run out.
As a store owner, I can receive low-stock notifications so that I can reorder from suppliers on time.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item with a threshold, When its stock falls below it, Then an alert is generated within 1 minute.
Given active alerts, When the manager opens the dashboard, Then low-stock items are listed with suggested reorder quantities.

features.name: Inventory Reports and Audit History
features.description: Provide stock reports and a full history of every inventory change for accountability.
user_stories: As a store owner, I can view stock and sales reports so that I understand inventory value and turnover.
As a store manager, I can review a change history by user so that I can investigate discrepancies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a date range, When a report is requested, Then it is generated within 5 seconds and exportable as CSV.
Given any stock change, When it is saved, Then the history records the user, time, item and quantity change.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Stock updates propagate to all connected clients within 2 seconds at 50 concurrent users.
All traffic uses HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ and access is enforced by role-based permissions with hashed passwords.
The system achieves 99.5% monthly uptime, with daily automated backups retained for 30 days.
A new clerk can complete a barcode scan and stock update within 3 taps after 15 minutes of training.
